persona_compliance.rationale: The agent consistently engages in polite, fair trades and refuses unfavorable deals, but never enacts the explicit tit-for-tat retaliation, threat language, or coordination on punishment that defines the 'Punisher' persona. There are refusals of bad trades but no mention of robber placement or proportional escalation.
supporting_examples: ORANGE, compliments won't get you a discount. I play fair, but I don't do bad trades.
violations: No threats or punishment language (e.g., no mention of placing the robber on defectors) across all negotiations.
Never references past defections or coordinates with other enforcers as the persona requires.

summary: The agent traded politely and refused unfavorable offers, but failed to demonstrate the punisher’s hallmark retaliatory threats or enforcement language, instead maintaining an overly cooperative and neutral tone throughout negotiations.
